result.title: Use Your Computer and Browser
result.description:
See how ChatGPT Work can help with tasks in your desktop apps and browser. Use Computer to start music in Spotify, then combine Chrome and Google Calendar to prepare a time-off request and an out-of-office event. Learn how to share screen context with Appshots, grant access, and review the drafts before submitting or saving anything. This walkthrough uses the ChatGPT desktop app.

Follow the lesson and try it yourself: https://learn.chatgpt.com/training/walkthroughs/using-your-computer-and-browser

result.title: Talk to ChatGPT Work
result.description:
Brainstorm out loud and turn your ideas into a presentation with Voice in ChatGPT Work. In the desktop app, talk through ideas for a team event, ask ChatGPT to build a visual pitch deck, and review the result. You’ll also see how to continue the same task from your phone by connecting to your computer through Remote.

Follow the lesson and try it yourself: https://learn.chatgpt.com/training/walkthroughs/using-voice

result.title: Create Slides, Docs, and Templates
result.description:
Turn a meeting transcript into a structured Google Doc and a leadership deck with ChatGPT Work. Connect Google Drive, ask for the sections you need, and check the document against the original transcript. Then create a Google Slides presentation from the document and save both formats with Template Creator so you can use them again.

Follow the lesson and try it yourself: https://learn.chatgpt.com/training/walkthroughs/creating-slides-and-docs

result.title: Use ChatGPT Work on Your Phone
result.description:
Use ChatGPT Work on your phone to catch up on work and handle personal tasks before you reach your desk. Follow a Slack and Gmail catch-up, then review recent spending with the read-only Finances plugin. You’ll also see how to pair your phone with Remote to check progress and guide tasks running on your computer. For Remote, your computer needs to stay awake and online.

Follow the lesson and try it yourself: https://learn.chatgpt.com/training/walkthroughs/working-on-your-phone

result.title: Build a Shareable Site
result.description:
Turn a conversation into a website people can use with ChatGPT Work. Build a group-trip site with an itinerary, activity voting, and shared expenses, then refine it by asking for changes. See how to choose who can visit, manage your projects in Sites, and bring launch metrics and team updates together in a dashboard.

Follow the lesson and try it yourself: https://learn.chatgpt.com/training/walkthroughs/building-a-shareable-site
